adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the comparison uses the raw `guest` string (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), so a mixed-case input like `Test@Example.com` can bypass the blacklist. Similarly, attendee de-duplication is case-sensitive (`guest === attendee.email`), so mixed-case variants can be added as “new” even if the email already exists with different casing. The diff shows no normalization of `guests` before these checks.
